entities.name: Ihesia
entities.description: General-in-chief of Iwset in the Dark Age of Terisiare, a skilled seductress without magic.

entities.name: Lord Peemel
entities.description: Ruler of Iwset whom Ihesia worked under.

entities.name: Isak Glen'Dard
entities.description: Ihesia's lover, a shapeshifter employed as a triple agent.

events.summary: Ihesia employed Isak Glen'Dard as a triple agent, appearing to serve Peemel and Digody while reporting to her.
events.quote: She employed her lover, the shapeshifter Isak Glen'Dard to act as a triple agent

relations.quote: Ihesia was the general-in-chief of Iwset , working under Lord Peemel .
